text: Program Description Students mainly study in the basic theories and knowledge in math, foundamental physics, physical electronics, optoelectronics, microelectronics. And they will take the basic training at information electronic experiment technology, computer technology, the ability to design, research and develop electronic materials, component and system. This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in electronical materials, component, integrate circuit, developing and researching new technology, etc. Given the strong focus on Micro-Electronics, graduates will be particularly well equipped for employment in the micro-electronics industry. Main Courses: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, Computer Architecture Foundation and Logical Design, Introduction to Electronical Science and Technology, Signal and System, Fundamentals of Electronic Circuits, Micro Computer System and Interface, Theory of Electromagnetic Fields, Semiconductor Physics, Photoelectron Physical Basis, Electronic Device, VLSI Design, Display Technology, Photoelectronic Technique, Fiber Optic Communications, Digital Signal Processing, etc.
